notFound.title: This course isn't available
notFound.body: It may have been removed, or it isn't published yet.

enroll.done: You're enrolled. Start whenever you're ready.

unenroll.title: Unenroll from this course?
unenroll.body: Your progress is kept, so you can pick up where you left off if you enroll again.
unenroll.done: You've unenrolled. Your progress is kept.

banner.draft: This course is a draft. Only you and administrators can see it.
banner.pending_review: This course is waiting for review. It can't be edited until the review is done.
banner.rejected: This course was returned for changes. Edit it and submit it again.
banner.archived: This course is archived and hidden from the catalog.
banner.pendingRevision: Changes to this course are waiting for review. Learners see the published version until they're approved.

reviews.title: Learner reviews
reviews.empty: No reviews yet. Learners who take the course can rate it.

form.title: Rate this course
form.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
form.commentHint: What helped you, and what could be better?
form.commentTooLong: Keep your comment to {{max}} characters or fewer.
form.deleteBody: Your rating and comment will be removed from this course.

remove.title: Remove this review?
remove.body: It disappears from the course for everyone, and the course rating is recalculated. Use this for reviews that break the terms of use. It can't be undone.
